scope: Independent read-only preflight implementation review; this is not a result-quality or statistical-success decision

checks.evidence: Two frozen arms differ only by round_mismatch_budget=2 versus null and explicit no_round_cap=true. Both have no response cap and identical symmetric BEPC score parameters.

NoRoundCapBEPC passes initialization-only round2 to NoResponseCapBEPC then sets self.round_budget=math.inf before any request forward or candidate decision. All runtime scanner accesses use this instance value.
budgeted_scan is the only operative per-round mismatch gate. ExperimentalBEPC exhausted fast path and observer retirement depend only on the already infinite response budget; they cannot activate.

All 26 inherited runtime source bytes equal the previous frozen manifest. The new class overrides only construction/statistics, leaving BEPC score, Target/Draft forward, native margins, EOS, branch scan, first-longest selection, KV commits and stopping code unchanged.

Observer legal_paths covers the native tree. context(parent) uses committed history and real ancestors, not siblings or descendants; commit accepts arbitrary selected path length and contains no two-mismatch assumption.

cnets_ours topK_genrate first expands one Draft layer then iterates depth=3 further expansions: at most four Draft descendants plus root, and 29 selected Draft nodes plus root gives 30 Target query rows. Removing the cap does not deepen or widen the tree.
Subclass final_stats overrides the inherited hardcoded round2 with null and explicit round_cap_enabled=false; response budget is also null. Unit lifecycle serializes stats with allow_nan=False.

Three CPU-only tests passed: actual inherited BEPC finite-margin gate accepts four mismatches in the new arm and only two in control; repeated commits preserve observer/lifecycle; EOS/visible boundary/first-longest and unselected branch rules; 10000 randomized independent scanner comparisons.

Runner and validator compare control raw/visible tokens, acceptance lengths/paths and input identity with all previous dev/main controls. New paired methods use identical processed inputs and legal tree settings. No prior timing is substituted for a concurrent arm.

Given identical common committed history, all paths with at most two accepted mismatches have unchanged accepted length. A first different selected path therefore must accept at least three mismatches in the new arm, even if it selects a different leaf. Validator asserts this on the first changed path.
Pipeline waits for both GPU workers and checks no active GPU processes before validation/scoring; CPU official scoring is scheduled after both development and main generation.
All 232 paths in PRIOR_PRESERVATION.json independently rehashed unchanged; all 29 frozen active runtime hashes match current files. Frozen configuration and both arms reviewed before generation.

Before launch, the validator was strengthened: if no zipped common path differs, it requires equal path-list lengths and equal raw_token_ids. Current validator source hash was already captured after this edit.
